evidence_class: recorded replay of a live stream; the live capture itself (unsanitized) is private steward evidence (FND-1 live campaign, 2026-10-22)
cli_version_basis: discovered once per run by the documented adapter path `codex --version` before launch, because the exec --json stream reports no version; the native session file was not consulted
mode_and_route: CliCapture launch (opt-in integration): raw stdout, independent byte copy, flush per record
capture_command: Use your web search tool once to search for: example.com IANA reserved domain. Report the title of the most relevant result in one sentence. Do not run any shell commands.
scenario: web search (-c web_search=live) started and completed

live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome; distinct from storage finalization (recording.state) and acquisition extent (acquisition.status): EOF never implies success

sanitization: original thread id -> stand-in, wherever it occurs
web_search results: urls and contents (third-party material) -> labelled stand-ins; element count and members kept
privacy_review: local paths, home directory, session/thread ids, record uuids, user configuration names (agents, skills, plugins, commands, MCP servers), memory and socket paths and account rate-limit numbers replaced; tool ids, message ids, request ids and model names kept (opaque); prompt text is the deliberate synthetic task; reviewed FND-1 live campaign, 2026-10-22; web_search result urls/contents replaced; thread id replaced wherever it occurs
